drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 45-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.49, creatinine 1.04-1.09, hemoglobin 13.3-13.6, platelets 284-294, sodium 124-127, wbc 6.2-6.7; vitals dbp 77-83, heart_rate 70-75, map 90-96, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 115-121, spo2 97-99, temp 36.8-37
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Fluid restriction 1.2 L/day; Sodium chloride 1 g PO TID
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.05-1.1, hemoglobin 13.4-13.5, platelets 287-294, sodium 127-130, wbc 6-6.6; vitals dbp 78-82, heart_rate 72-75, map 92-95, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 115-122, spo2 97-99, temp 36.8-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 45-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
